model: Lender FCFE capitalisation at cost of equity (engine route)

historical_growth.fcf_cagr_basis: FCFE proxy = attributable NPAT x 60% payout capacity; tracks net income by construction. Statutory FCF is sign-indeterminate for a lender and is not used.
historical_growth.growth_rate_source: Sustainable growth = ROAE (7.7% FY2025, 8.5% H1 FY2026 annualised) x ~40% retention = 3.1-3.4%, cross-checked against H1 FY2026 attributable profit +2.7% YoY and management's qualitative 'steady growth in pre-provision operating profit'. Equity CAGR is not used: it was inflated by the RMB 2.95bn convertible-bond conversion in FY2025 and by retained earnings whose return has fallen with the tax rate.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5-yr CAGR +8.8% diverges from EPS 5-yr CAGR -6.2% and revenue +4.3%. Book grew through retention and CB conversion while attributable profit fell from RMB 6.2bn (FY2023) to RMB 3.9bn (FY2024-25) on an effective tax rate stepping 33.7% -> 43.7% -> 50.3% (withholding tax on PRC-to-HK dividend upstreaming) and the FY2025 dilution. Book growth overstates earning power; ROAE has compressed from 13.0% to 7.7%.
historical_growth.notes: Pre-tax profit was flat FY2024-FY2025 (RMB 8.02bn -> 8.03bn) and NIM expanded (4.48% -> 4.83%; H1 FY2026 5.50%) as funding cost fell to 3.79% and the higher-yield inclusive-finance (SME) book scaled (+125% interest income FY2025). Industrial operation revenue fell 17.9% in FY2025 and 6.0% in H1 FY2026. Asset quality steady: NPL 1.03%, overdue-30d 0.81%, provision coverage 228%.

scenario_narratives.base: Far East Horizon remains a ~8% ROAE wholesale-funded lessor paying out ~60% of profit. Attributable profit grows ~3-4% a year as the inclusive-finance book scales and funding costs stay low, while the industrial segments stop shrinking but do not drive growth. With ROE below an 11% cost of equity the business is worth less than book (justified P/B ~0.6x), but materially more than the current ~0.44x, so the equity case is a well-covered ~10% dividend yield plus modest growth rather than a re-rating to book.
scenario_narratives.bull: NIM holds above 5% as inclusive finance becomes a third of interest income, funding costs fall further, overseas equipment rental grows into a meaningful profit pool and Horizon Healthcare stabilises. ROAE recovers toward 10%, growth runs 5-7% for four years and the market re-rates the stock toward 0.8x book.
scenario_narratives.bear: The property downturn feeds through to SME and urban-platform credit losses; write-offs and provisions compress profit ~13% over two years, the payout is trimmed to conserve capital, and tighter leasing regulation caps book growth. The stock stays a deep-discount-to-book yield instrument with a shrinking dividend.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A lender is valued on the cash it can return to equity after funding its own book growth, discounted at the cost of equity, with the borrowings treated as operating funding rather than net debt. For Far East Horizon that stream is ~60% of attributable profit, and the question is whether an ~8% ROE business should trade at 0.44x book. At an 11% cost of equity and ~3% sustainable growth it should trade nearer 0.6x, so the stock screens as cheap, but the discount to book is largely deserved: ROE sits below the cost of equity, the tax rate has halved earning power since FY2023, and the industrial segments are shrinking. The margin of safety is the dividend, not a re-rating.
key_risks_to_valuation: Credit losses in the inclusive-finance (SME) and urban-platform books outrun the 228% provision coverage if the property downturn deepens
Effective tax rate (50.3% FY2025) rises further or stays elevated, keeping ROE structurally below the cost of equity
Wholesale funding cost reverses with PBOC policy or onshore credit stress, compressing the 4.4% net interest spread
Industrial segments (equipment rental -18% FY2025, hospitals -13%) keep shrinking and require fleet impairments
NFRA financial-leasing measures constrain balance-sheet growth or force sale-leaseback run-off
FX: RMB flows vs HKD quote; a weaker RMB lowers the HKD value one-for-one

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (HKEX regular close); 52-week range HK$5.02-8.54. FX from Yahoo CNYHKD=X, same date.
data_sources.financials: 3360.HK_Metrics.csv / core_metrics (RMB millions) from 3360.HK_Annual_FY2017-FY2025.txt and 3360.HK_HalfYear_H1-2024/2025/2026.txt; kpis table (NIM, spread, NPL, ROAE, NetAssetsPerShare, NetInterestEarningAssets). Share count and equity from the H1 FY2026 interim report (30 June 2026).
data_sources.qualitative: 3360.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-22); H1 FY2026 interim 'Future Outlook' and MD&A.

inputs.base_revenue_note: NOT revenue. On this route the engine's 'revenue' line carries the capitalised stream: FY2025 profit attributable to ordinary shareholders (RMB 3,888.5m, 3360.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt income statement). ebitda_margin is held at 100%, D&A/SBC/tax at 0 because the stream is already post-interest, post-tax, post-SBC and post-NCI; capex_pct_path is the share of profit retained to fund book growth, so FCF = NPAT x (1 - retention) = free cash flow to equity. Group FY2025 total revenue for reference: RMB 35,785m.
inputs.share_count_basis: 4,818,107,647 shares in issue at 30 June 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim, share capital note). Diluted EPS equals basic EPS in H1 FY2026 (RMB 0.47) so residual options and the last USD-denominated convertible stub are immaterial; held flat because option/award expense is already inside NPAT and the restricted-share awards are satisfied by trustee market purchases, not new issuance.
inputs.net_debt_note: Lender convention: borrowings of RMB 266.2bn and cash of RMB 16.2bn at 30 June 2026 are operating funding for the RMB 282.5bn interest-earning book, not net debt. The FCFE stream is already after RMB 8.9bn of annual borrowing costs; deducting the borrowings again would count the debt twice. No perpetual securities were outstanding at 30 June 2026 (redeemed FY2025).
inputs.fcf_note: last_fcf = FCFE = FY2025 NPAT 3,888.5 x (1 - 40% retention) = RMB 2,333m, which ties to the dividend policy (FY2025 declared dividends HK$0.56/share, 61% payout, about RMB 2.3bn). Statutory FCF (OCF - capex = RMB -1,768m FY2025) is dominated by lease-receivable origination and is not an owner-cash measure for a lender; it is deliberately not used.
inputs.sbc_source: Equity-settled share-based payment expense RMB 219.0m FY2025 (3360.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:9775) is an IFRS 2 charge already expensed inside the NPAT stream being capitalised, so no second deduction is made here; recorded as 0 to prevent a double count. EquityAwardTaxes nil (awards settled from trustee-held shares).
inputs.interest_income_note: Interest on the Group's own cash (RMB 155m FY2025) is operating income for a lender and stays in the stream.
inputs.buyback_note: Nil FY2025 and H1 FY2026; last repurchase RMB 317m in FY2024. Capital return is via dividends.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and all flows in RMB (CNY); H shares quoted in HKD on HKEX. fx_rate is model -> quote: 1 CNY = 1.1745 HKD (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-22T09:16Z). Per-share values are computed in RMB and multiplied by 1.1745 to reach HKD; the unsuffixed intrinsic values are HKD so they compare with current_price. No A-share or ADR dual listing exists for a parity check; the direction is confirmed by the company's own dividend translation (FY2025 final HK$0.31/share x 4,799m shares stated as approximately HK$1,466m). refresh_price.py moves the price but not this rate; re-date it on any later refresh.
inputs.wacc_rationale: The discount rate is a COST OF EQUITY in RMB terms, applied to an equity flow (no WACC blend; the debt is operating funding). Build: China 10-year CGB ~1.8% + China/HK equity risk premium ~6.5% x beta ~1.2 for an 83%-geared, wholesale-funded, non-bank-affiliated lessor = ~9.6%, plus ~1.4pp for conglomerate complexity (hospitals + equipment rental), an unseasoned fast-growing SME book, and a 50% effective tax rate that is policy-exposed: 11.0% base. Folder references: 2016.HK (CoE 11%) and 0998.HK (10.5%) for Chinese joint-stock banks, which have deposit funding this company lacks. Bull 10.0%, bear 12.5%.
inputs.lease_treatment: Not applicable to the capitalised stream: IFRS 16 lease interest and depreciation on the Group's own leased premises are inside NPAT. The Group's lease RECEIVABLES are the earning asset, not a financing item.
inputs.nci_treatment: The stream is profit attributable to ordinary shareholders, so the RMB 8.2bn non-controlling interest (mainly outside shareholders of Horizon Construction Development, 9930.HK) and the nil perpetual securities are already excluded. No separate NCI deduction.
inputs.notes: MODEL: Lender FCFE capitalisation at cost of equity, net debt held at zero, run through the Drivers engine with NPAT as the stream. Far East Horizon is a non-bank financial lessor (61% of revenue is interest income on a RMB 282bn book; 36% is equipment-rental and hospital operations consolidated into the same NPAT). The owner-FCF engine is meaningless here: OCF swings with lease-receivable origination (RMB -40.8bn in FY2017, +18.4bn in FY2019), and the RMB 266bn of borrowings are operating funding, not net debt. The dcf-methods routing table sends banks and deposit takers to residual income on tangible book and compounders to BVPS x exit P/B; FCFE at CoE is the algebraically equivalent form that the engine can run (FCFE = NPAT x (1 - g/ROE)), and it keeps the output comparable to the folder's other Chinese financials. P/B cross-check: justified P/B = (ROE - g)/(CoE - g) = (7.7 - 3.0)/(11.0 - 3.0) = 0.59x on BVPS RMB 10.99 = RMB 6.5/share, consistent with the base value. Fresh build (no prior DCF, no memory entry). Industrial segments are NOT valued separately: they are wholly consolidated, loss-free, and their earnings flow through the same attributable NPAT; a sum-of-parts would need segment capital allocation the filings do not give. Fiscal year ends 31 December; FY2025 = year to 31 Dec 2025; H1 FY2026 = six months to 30 June 2026.

bear.growth_rationale: China property/construction downturn deepens (H1 FY2026 real-estate investment -18%, new starts -23%): the unseasoned SME book's write-offs (already +153% in FY2025) rise, provision charges climb, equipment-rental pricing deflates further and hospital reimbursement tightens. Attributable profit falls ~13% over FY2026-27 and recovers only to ~2% growth. New NFRA leasing rules constrain balance-sheet growth.
bear.capex_rationale: Retention raised to 45% (payout cut to ~55%) as the board conserves capital against credit losses; a lender does not release equity in a downturn even when the book stops growing.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +3.0%: H1 FY2026 attributable profit +2.7% YoY with NIM expansion offsetting industrial weakness; the 50% effective tax rate persists while dividends are upstreamed. FY2027-29 3.5-4.0%: inclusive-finance book keeps scaling, funding cost tailwind fades, domestic equipment rental stabilises off a low base. Fade to 2.5% by FY2033 (Chinese nominal GDP-minus). Growth above the retention-funded ~3% in FY2027-29 is supportable from the capital headroom the FY2025 CB conversion created (equity/assets stable at ~14%).
base.capex_rationale: capex_pct = retention of attributable profit to fund book growth, held at 40% (60% payout), matching the 61% FY2025 payout and management's reiterated 'steady and generous' distribution policy. At ROAE ~7.7-8.5% this retention funds ~3.1-3.4% growth, which brackets the terminal rate.
base.wacc_note: Cost of equity in RMB terms (see inputs.wacc_rationale); the Drivers field name is the engine's.
base.terminal_note: Gordon terminal at (11.0% - 2.5%) implies ~12x FCFE / ~7x NPAT; cap of 15 is non-binding.

bull.growth_rationale: Inclusive finance keeps compounding at structurally higher yields (NIM holds above 5%), PBOC stays accommodative so funding cost falls further, overseas equipment rental (Middle East/SE Asia) offsets domestic deflation and Horizon Healthcare stabilises; ROAE recovers toward 10%, letting 40% retention fund 4%+ growth. Tax rate eases if the group retains more onshore.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear lifted from the house 15% to 25%: 83.6% gearing with no deposit base, direct exposure to China's property/construction cycle through both the book and the equipment-rental fleet, an unseasoned fast-growing SME book, and a 50% effective tax rate that depends on PRC withholding policy. Bull trimmed to 25%: asset quality is demonstrably stable (NPL 1.03%, coverage 228%) and NIM is expanding, so a recovery is credible, but the industrial segments have declined for two consecutive years with no domestic turning point.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
